description: A sequential switch passing one input to one of eight outputs, stepped by triggers or placed directly by a voltage

params.text: Sets how many of the eight steps are cycled through, a whole number from 1 to 8
Jumps straight to that step, and lights while that step is the selected one

inputs.text: The signal routed to whichever step's output is selected
A rising edge moves on by one step, wrapping round at the set number of steps
A rising edge moves back by one step, wrapping round at the set number of steps
A rising edge returns the switch to step 1
Sets how many steps are cycled through from its voltage, one step per volt from 1V to 8V, and the knob has no effect while a cable is patched here, despite the wiki giving the range as 0-8V
Selects the step directly from its voltage, spread across the set number of steps, and the trigger inputs have no effect while a cable is patched here
A rising edge jumps to a step picked at random from the set number of steps

outputs.text: Carries the In signal while that step is the selected one; at other times it gives 0V or holds the voltage it last carried, as the menu is set

menu: Output Mode — Zero sends 0V from the outputs that are not selected, and Last leaves them holding the voltage they last carried, which makes the module a shift register driven in any order
Input Range — the voltage span the Step input is spread across, either 0-8V, 0-6V, 0-10V or -5V to 5V

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
